title: Automated packaging line
brief: Replace the end-of-line packing cell at the East plant. Evaluate integration with existing conveyors, throughput at 40 cases/min, commissioning lead time, and local service coverage.

title: Compressed air system
brief: Upgrade two compressors and add energy monitoring. Compare installation downtime, maintenance support, and total scope.
decision_notes: Recommend Bayline for its local service coverage and installation plan. Procurement approval and contracting remain outside this review.

title: Annual safety supplies
brief: Consolidate PPE and consumables across both plants. Prioritize dependable replenishment and a transparent price schedule.
